title: Hephaestus config (defaults / override)
description: Effective per-request config: setup/defaults.json (collection-wide `hephaestus.defaults`) deep-merged with the per-request `override` object. Enumerates every key the v3.9 engine actually reads. Known keys autocomplete; unknown custom keys are tolerated (additionalProperties is open) so plugin/custom fields are never red-flagged.

$schema.description: Editor-only JSON Schema association (e.g. ../docs/override.schema.json). Ignored by the engine and stripped from the shipped collection at build time.

_comment.description: Non-engine annotation used in the shipped setup/defaults.json template. Delete before copying into collectionVariables['hephaestus.defaults'].

baseUrl.description: API base address; protocol is prepended from defaultProtocol if omitted. Exposed as {{baseUrl}}.

defaultProtocol.description: Protocol prepended to baseUrl when none is given (default: https).

enabled.description: Master switch. When false the auth block is ignored entirely.

fields.description: For type headers: header name -> value. For type variables: pm.variable name -> value.

oauth2cc.description: OAuth2 client_credentials grant (type: oauth2cc). Token cached in collection vars and auto-refreshed.

clientSecret.description: OAuth2 client_secret. If omitted, falls back to the OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET environment variable.

extraParams.description: Extra form-body parameters added to the token request.

dateFormat.description: Format for the built-in date variables and dates expressions (tokens: yyyy MM dd hh mm ss nnn tt00). Default: yyyy-MM-dd.

dates.description: Custom date variables: variable name -> expression (today, yesterday, tomorrow, startOfMonth, endOfMonth, startOfNextMonth, endOfNextMonth, startOfPrevMonth, endOfPrevMonth, startOfYear, endOfYear, today+7d / today-1m / today+1y ...).

maxResponseTime.description: Maximum allowed response time in milliseconds; fails the test if slower.

expectedStatus.description: Expected HTTP status code(s). A number or a list; response passes if its code is included. Drives negative testing. Default: [200, 201, 202].

expectEmpty.description: Set true for requests that return an empty body (e.g. 204). Inverts the body-not-empty assertion.

contentType.description: Expected response content type; asserted as a substring of the response Content-Type, so 'json' or a full MIME like 'application/json' both work.

snapshot.description: Response snapshot regression. Disabled unless enabled:true (or record:true).

storage.description: Snapshot backend. postman-api is unavailable offline and falls back to collection-vars.

mode.description: strict = full deep-equal; non-strict = every baseline key must be present in the current response. Default: non-strict.

autoSaveMissing.description: When no baseline exists, save the current response as baseline instead of failing. Default: true.

checkPaths.description: Only these JSONPath-lite paths are compared (shrinks stored snapshot).

ignorePaths.description: Paths excluded from comparison (e.g. volatile timestamps/ids).

record.description: Force-overwrite the baseline for this request on the next run, then remove the flag. Works standalone (no enabled needed).

snapshotRecord.description: Top-level alias for snapshot.record: force-overwrite the snapshot baseline on the next run.

schema.description: JSON Schema validation of the parsed response via tv4 (draft-04/07). Disabled unless enabled:true.

definition.description: The JSON Schema to validate the response against.

securityAudit.description: Passive response security audit. Disabled unless enabled:true. Providing a list replaces the corresponding built-in default.

requireHeaders.description: Protective headers that must be present (default: HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options).

forbidHeaders.description: Server-disclosure headers that must be absent (default: server, x-powered-by, x-aspnet-version).

forbidBodyPatterns.description: Substrings that must NOT appear in the body (leaked errors / stack traces).

checkCors.description: Fail when Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * is paired with Allow-Credentials: true. Default: true.

soft.description: Report findings as passing warnings instead of failing the run. Does NOT inherit the global softFail flag.

secrets.description: Key-name fragments whose values are masked in logs (substring, case-insensitive).

envRequired.description: Environment variables that must be set (non-empty) before the request is sent.

ci.description: Emit a structured [HEPHAESTUS_CI] JSON line per request, regardless of logLevel.

softFail.description: Global soft mode: functional assertion failures are logged as warnings instead of failing the run.

randomData.description: Generate pm.variables before the request: variable name -> generator (random.uuid, random.email, random.bool, random.str, random.str:N, random.int:min:max, random.float:min:max:dec, random.date) or a literal string.

keysToFind.description: Assert fields exist (and optionally match a value) at the given JSONPath-lite paths.

anyOf.description: Shorthand: a path that must exist (name = path).

name.description: Label for the test (defaults to path).

expect.description: Expected value (deep-equal) or a JS predicate function (override only).

transform.description: JS function(s) applied to the value before checking (override only).

filter.description: JS function(s) filtering an array value (override only).

soft.description: Do not fail if the field is missing; warn only.

when.description: Guard: run the assertion only when this is truthy (JS expression string or function).

varsToSave.description: Extract-and-save: alias -> spec. Saves the value at path into a Postman variable.

transform.description: JS function(s) applied before saving (override only).

filter.description: JS function(s) filtering an array value (override only).

keysToCount.description: Count entries: alias -> spec. Asserts the number of array/object entries at path.

path.description: JSONPath-lite path to the array (or object).

expected.description: Exact expected count (omit to just report the number).

type.description: Count array elements or object entries. Default: array.

filter.description: JS predicate to filter items before counting (override only).

transformBefore.description: JS map applied to each item before filtering (override only).

transformAfter.description: JS function applied to the array after filtering (override only).

assertions.description: Shorthand assertion map: field path -> operators. All operators combine.

assertEach.description: Validate every element of an array against a set of per-field rules.

rules.description: Per-element rules: field name -> operators (same operators as assertions).

assertShape.description: One-line structural type checks: field path -> expected type.

assertOrder.description: Assert an array is sorted by a field.

by.description: Field to compare by (dot path within each element).

assertUnique.description: Assert all array elements are unique (by value, or by a field).

by.description: Field to dedupe by (optional; whole element if omitted).

assertHeaders.description: Assert response headers exist / match / are absent.

expect.description: Expected value: a substring the header must contain, or a JS predicate (override only).

retryOnStatus.description: Auto-retry the request while its status is in the list (setNextRequest). Skips the rest of the pipeline on intermediate attempts.

statuses.description: Status code(s) that trigger a retry.

fieldRule.description: Assertion operators for a single field. All present operators must pass.

exists.description: true: field must exist; false: field must be absent/null.

type.description: typeof / structural type of the value.

includes.description: Array includes this element, or string contains this substring.

soft.description: Log as a warning instead of failing.

when.description: Guard: run only when this is truthy (JS expression string or function).
